sources.fact: LBBD95/WC Selinas Lane is 0.62ha with 150 minimum/maximum net dwelling capacity.
The Brownfield field planning-permission-status is permissioned.
The same current Brownfield record simultaneously states Notes: No decision taken on planning application.
Planning history links to Be First application id 21825; this wave does not infer a final residential permission solely from the conflicting register fields.
WC provides a point and blank geometry; this is not the application red-line or HMLR title polygon.
Ownership status not-owned-by-a-public-authority does not identify current proprietor/title.
22/01424/FULL at Dairy Crest/Chadwell House, Selinas Lane concerns industrial buildings; it is not transferred to the WC residential allocation.
December 2022 committee minutes confirm industrial B2/B8/E(g)(iii) scope at another Selinas Lane site, demonstrating address-area collision risk.
21/02059/FULL at former Muller Factory Selinas Lane is a temporary industrial/open-storage/car-dealership use and is not WC residential permission evidence.
Local Plan allocation supports housing capacity evidence but does not cure a contradictory planning-permission-status record.
Exact case/decision readback is required to resolve the permissioned versus no-decision conflict.
Brownfield register fields remain evidence inputs and are not substituted for exact legal title or executed statutory overlays.

examples.result: The status field says permissioned but the note says no decision taken; conflict is preserved, not silently reconciled.
No final residential permission conclusion is promoted from contradictory fields alone.
Industrial Selinas Lane applications are not transferred to WC.
Be First history id is retained without guessing an exact final decision outcome.
Point/blank geometry is not converted to a site/title polygon.
Non-public ownership category is not legal proprietor identification.
Promotion remains zero until the exact residential case decision, title relation and overlays are verified.
